question: Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru were executed on __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**March 23, 1931**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **"Monday, March 23 1931" Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru** were executed.
 
• Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru were Indian freedom fighters who were involved in the Indian independence movement against British rule.
 
• They were sentenced to death for their involvement in the Lahore Conspiracy Case, which was a conspiracy to assassinate James A. Scott, a British police officer who had ordered lathi charge on Lala Lajpat Rai resulting in his death.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhagat Singh** took involved in the unintentional killing of a subordinate British policeman as payback for the killing of an Indian nationalist. 
 
• **Sukhdev Thapar** battled the British administration to secure India's independence. He belonged to the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association. On March 23, 1931, he was killed alongside Shivaram Rajguru and Bhagat Singh. 
 
• An Indian revolutionary from Maharashtra named **Shivaram Hari Rajguru** gained notoriety for his role in the assassination of John Saunders, a British police officer.
